arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - << 'PYEOF'
import json, random, subprocess, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
from gen2 import gen
from invariants import check
rng = random.Random(777)
bad=0; maxn=0
for trial in range(40):
    doc = gen(rng)
    maxn = max(maxn, len(doc["packets"]))
    p = subprocess.run(['python3','/workspace/submission/main.py'], input=json.dumps(doc).encode(), stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
    out = json.loads(p.stdout)
    if "error" in out:
        print("TRIAL", trial, "rejected!", len(doc["packets"])); bad+=1; break
    errs = check(doc, out)
    if errs:
        bad+=1; print("TRIAL",trial,"errors",len(errs), errs[:4])
        json.dump(doc, open('/workspace/tmp/fail3.json','w'))
        if bad>2: break
print("done bad:", bad, "max packets", maxn)
PYEOF
